meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw,用手机短信直接对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 iPhone,想通过短信和助手直接联系。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw and chat via text messages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use iPhone and want to reach your assistant via iMessage.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 iMessage 渠道:复制并注册 iMessage 适配器、安装依赖、构建并测试;然后选择本地(macOS,需完全磁盘访问权限)或远程(Photon)模式配置凭据,重启服务后即可通过 iMessage 收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等触发词,或要求接入 iMessage 时触发。

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and tests, then configures local macOS or remote Photon credentials. After restart, it sends and receives iMessages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'add imessage', 'connect imessage', 'add photon', 'imessage via photon', or 'native imessage'.

say_en.note: Claude copies and registers the iMessage adapter
Uses remote mode; you'll provide server URL and API key

say_en.text: Set up iMessage in local mode
say_en.note: Uses this Mac; you'll grant Full Disk Access
